title: Testing out the posting functionality with this pic of us celebrating the last World Cup.
We're Going to the World Cup!
body: It's official — tickets, flights, and a very excited family ready to experience the World Cup on American soil. Three USA group stage matches, West Coast National Parks, the Grand Canyon, and a lot of miles in between. Follow along here for updates, photos, and the live map of where we are.
